Dear [Mrs Suckling](/person/1380)

Would you be so kind as to send the prospectus or at any rate some papers about the [Band of Mercy](/organisation/265) to [Mr Streatfield](/person/2438) the clergyman of Kingsworthy (Winchester)  I am afraid I dont know his Christian name, but he seemed much inclined to join it with his schoolchildren, and I promised him to ask you to send him the papers

yours truly

C M Yonge
